title: MailMind
description: An AI-powered email intelligence platform that extracts tasks, meetings, orders and useful information from emails while preparing replies for the user to review.

detail.problem: Modern inboxes are noisy. Important tasks get buried under promotions and threads, meetings get missed, and useful information — like order confirmations or travel itineraries — is scattered across hundreds of emails with no easy way to surface it.
detail.solution: MailMind connects to your Gmail, reads incoming emails using NLP, and automatically classifies them into actionable categories: tasks, meetings, orders, and general info. It extracts structured data from each, prepares draft replies for review, and presents everything in a clean dashboard — turning email chaos into organized intelligence.

title: FlexPlus
description: A browser extension that redesigns the FAST NUCES student portal into a calmer, clearer and more useful experience.

detail.problem: The FAST NUCES student portal (FlexStudent) has a cluttered, confusing interface. Students struggle to find grades, schedules, and fee information buried under layers of poor navigation, inconsistent styling, and unnecessary complexity.
detail.solution: FlexPlus is a browser extension that injects cleaner CSS and restructured layouts directly into the existing portal. It reorganizes navigation, simplifies the grade view, adds a proper timetable display, and strips away visual clutter — all without needing access to the backend or any data leaving the browser.

title: Sepsis Analysis
description: A machine-learning pipeline designed to identify patients at risk of sepsis using irregular and highly incomplete ICU time-series data.

detail.problem: Sepsis is a leading cause of death in ICUs, but early detection is extremely difficult. Patient vital signs are recorded irregularly, with large gaps and missing values, making it hard for traditional models to learn reliable patterns from the data.
detail.solution: This pipeline handles irregular, incomplete ICU time-series data through careful imputation, feature engineering, and temporal modeling. It uses gradient-boosted trees with hand-crafted statistical features (rolling means, deltas, missing-data indicators) to flag at-risk patients hours before clinical onset — giving doctors a crucial early warning window.

title: Lookbook Cropper
description: An MVP SaaS platform that automates the tedious task of extracting individual product photos from multi-page brand lookbooks, featuring asynchronous background processing and an interactive cropping UI.

detail.problem: Fashion brands distribute product catalogs as multi-page PDF lookbooks. Extracting individual product images from these PDFs is a tedious manual process — designers and e-commerce teams spend hours cropping, aligning, and exporting each product photo one by one.
detail.solution: Lookbook Cropper lets users upload a PDF, automatically detects product boundaries on each page, and extracts individual product images. Users can fine-tune crops through an interactive UI before downloading. Processing happens asynchronously in the background, so users can queue multiple lookbooks without waiting.
